cases.name: Jennifer Lopez
cases.about:
Her mother Maria Lopez made a statement in court at his sentencing and said her daughter was looking forward to her 21st birthday, starting her own business and continuing her cosmetology studies. She said Jennifer was the oldest of her children and always took care of them. The family still sets a place at the table for Jennifer.
